text:
Alex: FYI SynTech kicked off POC today. They requested a 14d trial, 250k token credit, and asked for a PO + signed order form by Thursday EOD. Can we approve the credit and confirm sign routing?
Nina: Confirmed 14 days. They said PO hinges on DPA + order form. Who signs off on trial credit? cc @Samir for pricing.
Samir: Finance will ok a capped pilot instead of pure free credits. Two options: free 250k tokens OR discounted pilot with an invoice cap. I prefer discounted pilot with cap to simplify billing (we can auto-bill if they exceed).
Priya (Legal): Customer redlined the DPA: added a data residency paragraph and wants to reference their KMS vendor in our HSM/KMS clause. Also inserted a 99.5% SLA for the POC. We should not accept SLA on a POC.
Alex: Agreed on SLA. Propose we convert that to "informational target for demo only" and keep no contractual uptime for POCs. On KMS vendor: need attestation if we reference their vendor.
Marco (Ops): I can create the DocuSign envelope. Routing per procurement@syntech.com + legal@syntech.com. If they send a PO we should attach it and set invoice terms to net30. Example:
```bash
rdw-docsign create-envelope --template "POC-ORDERFORM" --to procurement@syntech.com --to legal@syntech.com --merge PO_NUMBER=<<PO>> --notes "POC order form + DPA"
```
DocuSignBot: Envelope created (env_id: d5f7a2c1). Status: sent -> awaiting signatures. https://docusign.example/env/d5f7a2c1
Nina: Procurement contact is procurement@syntech.com, CFO celine@syntech.com on copy. They asked invoice to show "pilot credit applied" and include PO ref.
Samir: Draft billing lines:
LineItem: POC credits 250,000 tokens @ $0.00 (trial credit)
PilotRate: 100k tokens @ $0.018/token (billable, capped to $3,000)
InvoiceTerms: Net 30
Recommend we publish the capped pilot rate in the order form so billing can proceed automatically.
Priya (Legal): Proposed redline: remove SLA from POC contract, accept data residency clause subject to our DPA addendum, and change KMS clause to "customer-managed key references accepted pending vendor attestation and security review." I will not countersign until we receive attestation.
Alex: Uploaded order form + redline: https://drive.example/syntech/poc-orderform-redline — please review and add comments.
Marco (Ops): Envelope updated to include Drive link and PO placeholder. Sent to procurement@syntech.com.
Nina: I emailed procurement + CFO requesting PO issuance and KMS vendor attestation today. Subject: "Redwood POC — PO + KMS attestation required for countersign."
Samir: Finance checklist before invoicing: PO received, envelope signed, invoice term = Net 30, pilot cap confirmed. I will trigger billing when DocuSign shows completed.
Priya (Legal): If SynTech insists on KMS vendor language, we need their vendor SOC/attestation. Otherwise we accept the language as a reference only and require keys not used for production during the POC.
Alex: Action items: Nina follow up procurement by 3pm PT; Marco monitor envelope; Priya await attestation and will prep countersign; Samir ready to approve pilot cap billing. Well revert here with envelope completion or blocker updates. :thumbsup:
